set up cld's completion in a shell, one of the commands below: cld writes the
script that cld completion SHELL prints where the shell reads it. TAB then
completes cld's commands, their options and the names cld list shows. cld
update writes the script anew where the release it installs prints another.

Usage:
  cld setup completion [command]

Available Commands:
  bash        set up cld's completion in bash
  zsh         set up cld's completion in zsh
  fish        set up cld's completion in fish

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for completion

Use "cld setup completion [command] --help" for more information about a command.
